SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SALES A WHERE 1=1
AND A.SALES_TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')

SELECT A.SALES_ID AS salesId , A.CUST_ID AS custId , A.SALES_USER_ID AS salesUserId , A.SALES_TITLE AS salesTitle , A.EXPECTED_AMT AS expectedAmt , A.EXPECTED_DT AS expectedDt , A.PROBABILITY AS probability , A.STATUS AS status , A.SALES_CONTENT AS salesContent , A.REG_DT AS regDt , B.CUST_NM AS customerName , C.USER_NM AS salesUserName FROM TB_SALES A LEFT JOIN TB_CUSTOMER B ON A.CUST_ID = B.CUST_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER C ON A.SALES_USER_ID = C.USER_ID WHERE A.SALES_ID = #{salesId}
